newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WSC Australia Grains and Wheat Weather.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WSC Australia Grains and Wheat Weather.

text.p: As of 06:29 GMT, 30 OCT 1996 SUMMARY- Mostly dry. Highs 64-86F (18-30C) west, 64-81F (18-27C) east.
CROP IMPACT- Drier weather is more favorable for winter crop harvests.
TODAY...Mostly cloudy in the west with light to moderate showers of 0.10-0.50 inch (2-13mm). Sunny to partly cloudy in the east. Highs 66-80F (19-26C) west, 65-82F (18-27C).
TONIGHT...Fair in the east. Light to moderate showers west.
TOMORROW...Showers in the west. Mostly sunny in the east. Highs
OUTLOOK...Slow clearing in the west this period. Increasing clouds in the east early in the period with showers developing by the weekend. Temperatures average near to below normal.
